sources.excerpt: Restaurant-controlled homepage identifies CHIKO as a Chinese-Korean restaurant in Washington, DC from The Fried Rice Collective.
Official location page lists DC Capitol Hill at 423 8th St SE and DC Dupont at 2029 P St NW and links each location's Toast storefront.
Restaurant-controlled menu gallery publishes current general, beverage, and gluten-free menu boards; location-specific Toast menus provide the complete live product inventory.
The catering provider linked by mychiko.com states that CHIKO favorites and off-menu items are available for larger groups and links the current CHIKO 2026 package.

CHIKO-branded 2026 catering package provides lunch-box and platter products plus a non-exhaustive restrictions page. It names products containing seafood or nuts, says ingredients cannot be guaranteed allergen-free, and says sesame allergies cannot be accommodated.
Live Toast storefront linked by CHIKO for Capitol Hill at 423 8th St SE, including specials, food, gluten-free and vegetarian presentations, marketplace products, and nonalcoholic drinks.
Live Toast storefront linked by CHIKO for Dupont at 2029 P St NW, including specials, food, gluten-free and vegetarian presentations, and nonalcoholic drinks.

Toast item customization accepts shellfish, nut, gluten, soy, and dairy allergy requests. This operational request field is not an item allergen matrix and is not treated as a contains or absence claim.

Official-domain navigation, menu images, catering links, FAQ/document terms, and downloadable surfaces were inspected. The CHIKO 2026 catering package was the only official allergen-bearing document found.

Targeted CHIKO/domain searches found the current official site, live linked Toast menus, allergy-request modifier, and current 2026 catering package; no separate restaurant allergen matrix or nutrition guide was found.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: The CHIKO 2026 catering package states that its allergy list is not exhaustive and that ingredients cannot be guaranteed free of allergens.
The CHIKO 2026 catering package states that sesame allergies cannot be accommodated.

findings.summary: The record is a DC union of Capitol Hill and Dupont; repeated products were consolidated while Virginia locations were excluded.

The current CHIKO 2026 catering package is an official allergen-bearing document. Preserve its explicit contains-seafood and contains-nuts claims and its restaurant-level inability to guarantee allergen-free ingredients or accommodate sesame allergies.

The official document uses the broad term seafood. Named shrimp/crab products are stored as shellfish and salmon as fish; products whose seafood subtype is not identified use the canonical other allergen signal rather than guessing fish or shellfish.
Gluten-free or vegan availability labels are not converted into unsupported allergen-absence claims, and restaurant-level cross-contact limitations are not smeared into item mayContain arrays.

proposedChanges: Replace the 58-row frozen projection with the 88-product current DC boundary across Capitol Hill, Dupont, and current 2026 catering.
Consolidate repeated location, vegetarian, catering, singular/plural, and one-piece presentations while retaining every official source reference.
Remove stale Dan Dan Noodles, preserve current Wing Bucket, and add current specials, nonalcoholic drinks, and catering-only products.
Promote the current CHIKO 2026 catering package as the highest-authority direct allergen source and preserve its restaurant-level cross-contact and sesame-accommodation limitations separately.
Replace unsupported frozen ingredient/allergen arrays with only explicit current direct-source positives; leave other item allergen status unavailable.
